findings.issue: Task 16 implementation hint (line 114) still says 'git diff dev -- tests/' for computing the test count delta. This command correctly returns results only if the current HEAD is on the feature branch and dev is the base. If the agent is on a detached HEAD or has already merged into dev, the diff will be empty (0 added, 0 deleted), producing a false delta. This hint was flagged as major in R1 but the text was not updated.
findings.fix: Update hint to: 'git diff $(git merge-base HEAD dev) HEAD -- tests/' to compute the delta from the branch-point rather than assuming the current branch is not dev. Also add: 'Confirm you are on the feature branch before running this command.'
